name: reference
note: The frontier model, bare, on the held-out set. Not a contradiction of 'cheap only': without a bar there is nothing for C to be compared to.

items.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
  AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
WHERE region = 'APAC'
  AND is_internal = FALSE
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
WHERE region = 'ANZ'
  AND is_internal = FALSE
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(
            CASE o.currency
                WHEN 'EUR' THEN (o.amount_minor / 100.0) * $usd_per_eur
                WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * $usd_per_jpy
            END
        ),
        0
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT c.is_internal;

SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR'), 0) / 100.0
        AS gross_revenue_eur,
    COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'JPY'), 0)
        AS gross_revenue_jpy,
    NULL::DECIMAL(38, 2) AS gross_revenue_usd,
    'USD conversion requires EUR/USD and JPY/USD exchange rates, which are not provided.'
        AS conversion_note
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
  AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN amount_minor / 100.0 * $eur_to_usd_rate
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN amount_minor * $jpy_to_usd_rate
        END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
  AND currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND status = 'paid'
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE o.currency
                WHEN 'EUR' THEN (o.amount_minor / 100.0) * $usd_per_eur
                WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * $usd_per_jpy
            END
        ),
        2
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT c.is_internal;

SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR'), 0) / 100.0
        AS gross_revenue_eur,
    COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'JPY'), 0)
        AS gross_revenue_jpy,
    NULL::DECIMAL(38, 2) AS gross_revenue_usd,
    'USD revenue cannot be calculated without EUR-to-USD and JPY-to-USD exchange rates.'
        AS conversion_note
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

WITH january_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.currency, o.amount_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND NOT c.is_internal
),
refunds_by_order AS (
    SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
    FROM refunds AS r
    JOIN january_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
    GROUP BY r.order_id
),
net_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0) AS net_minor
    FROM january_orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN refunds_by_order AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(net_minor) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR'), 0) / 100.0
        AS net_revenue_eur,
    COALESCE(SUM(net_minor) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'JPY'), 0)
        AS net_revenue_jpy,
    NULL::DECIMAL(38, 2) AS net_revenue_usd,
    'USD conversion requires EUR/USD and JPY/USD exchange rates, which are not supplied.'
        AS conversion_note
FROM net_amounts;

WITH exchange_rates AS (
    SELECT 'EUR' AS currency, 100.0 AS minor_units_per_unit,
           CAST($eur_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8)) AS usd_per_unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'JPY', 1.0,
           CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8))
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT o.*, fx.minor_units_per_unit, fx.usd_per_unit
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN exchange_rates AS fx ON fx.currency = o.currency
    WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND NOT c.is_internal
),
revenue_events AS (
    SELECT
        o.amount_minor / o.minor_units_per_unit * o.usd_per_unit AS amount_usd
    FROM eligible_orders AS o
    WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        -r.amount_minor / o.minor_units_per_unit * o.usd_per_unit
    FROM refunds AS r
    JOIN eligible_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(amount_usd), 0), 2) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM revenue_events;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT o.*
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND NOT c.is_internal
),
revenue_movements AS (
    SELECT currency, amount_minor AS net_minor
    FROM eligible_orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
      AND status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT o.currency, -r.amount_minor AS net_minor
    FROM refunds AS r
    JOIN eligible_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN net_minor / 100.0 * CAST($eur_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8))
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN net_minor * CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8))
        END
    ), 0),
    2
) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM revenue_movements;

WITH exchange_rates AS (
    SELECT 'EUR' AS currency, 100.0 AS minor_units_per_unit,
           CAST($eur_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8)) AS usd_per_unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'JPY', 1.0, CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8))
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(SUM(
            (o.amount_minor - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0))
            / fx.minor_units_per_unit * fx.usd_per_unit
        ), 0),
        2
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN exchange_rates AS fx ON fx.currency = o.currency
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
  AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT c.is_internal;

WITH exchange_rates AS (
    SELECT 'EUR' AS currency, 100.0 AS minor_units_per_unit,
           CAST($eur_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8)) AS usd_per_unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'JPY', 1.0, CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8))
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
    FROM refunds
    WHERE issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(
    SUM(
        (o.amount_minor - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0))
        / fx.minor_units_per_unit
        * fx.usd_per_unit
    ),
    0
) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN exchange_rates AS fx ON fx.currency = o.currency
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
  AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT c.is_internal;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.currency, o.amount_minor, o.placed_at
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND NOT c.is_internal
),
june_movements AS (
    SELECT currency, amount_minor AS net_amount_minor
    FROM eligible_orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT o.currency, -r.amount_minor AS net_amount_minor
    FROM refunds AS r
    JOIN eligible_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
      AND r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN net_amount_minor / 100.0 * $usd_per_eur
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN net_amount_minor * $usd_per_jpy
        END
    ), 0),
    2
) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM june_movements;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'electronics'
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'home'
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'outdoors'
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'beauty'
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'garden'
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor / 100.0 * $usd_per_eur
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * $usd_per_jpy
        END
    ) AS average_order_value_usd_before_refunds
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'NA'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND NOT c.is_internal
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN (o.amount_minor / 100.0) * $eur_to_usd
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * $jpy_to_usd
        END
    ) AS average_order_value_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'EMEA'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND NOT c.is_internal
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT AVG(
    CASE o.currency
        WHEN 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor / 100.0 * CAST($eur_to_usd AS DOUBLE)
        WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DOUBLE)
    END
) AS average_order_value_usd_before_refunds
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'APAC'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND NOT c.is_internal
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor / 100.0 * CAST($eur_to_usd AS DOUBLE)
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DOUBLE)
        END
    ) AS average_order_value_usd_before_refunds
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'LATAM'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND NOT c.is_internal
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL;

WITH exchange_rates AS (
    -- USD exchange rates are not available in the supplied schema.
    SELECT *
    FROM (VALUES
        ('EUR', 100.0, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)),
        ('JPY',   1.0, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE))
    ) AS r(currency, minor_units_per_unit, usd_per_unit)
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.amount_minor,
        r.minor_units_per_unit,
        r.usd_per_unit
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN exchange_rates AS r ON r.currency = o.currency
    WHERE c.region = 'ANZ'
      AND NOT c.is_internal
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(usd_per_unit) = COUNT(*) THEN
            AVG(amount_minor / minor_units_per_unit * usd_per_unit)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS average_order_value_usd_before_refunds,
    'EUR-to-USD and JPY-to-USD exchange rates are required but not provided.'
        AS conversion_note
FROM eligible_orders;

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor / 100.0 * $eur_to_usd
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * $jpy_to_usd
        END
    ) AS average_order_value_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'MEA'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT
    SUM(
        oi.qty::DECIMAL(18, 0) * oi.unit_price_minor
        * CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN $eur_to_usd / 100.0
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN $jpy_to_usd
          END
    ) AS gross_apparel_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'apparel'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT
    SUM(
        CAST(oi.qty AS DOUBLE) * oi.unit_price_minor *
        CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN $eur_to_usd / 100.0
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN $jpy_to_usd
        END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'electronics'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT
    SUM(
        oi.qty::DOUBLE * oi.unit_price_minor
        * CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN $eur_to_usd / 100.0
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN $jpy_to_usd
          END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'home'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT
    SUM(
        CAST(oi.qty AS DOUBLE) * oi.unit_price_minor *
        CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN $eur_to_usd_rate / 100.0
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN $jpy_to_usd_rate
        END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'outdoors'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(
            CAST(oi.qty AS DOUBLE) * oi.unit_price_minor *
            CASE o.currency
                WHEN 'EUR' THEN CAST($eur_to_usd AS DOUBLE) / 100.0
                WHEN 'JPY' THEN CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DOUBLE)
            END
        ),
        0.0
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'beauty'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT
    o.currency,
    SUM(oi.qty::HUGEINT * oi.unit_price_minor)
        / CASE WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN 100.0 ELSE 1.0 END
        AS gross_revenue_native,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS gross_revenue_usd,
    'USD revenue cannot be calculated without EUR/USD and JPY/USD exchange rates.'
        AS conversion_note
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'garden'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
GROUP BY o.currency
ORDER BY o.currency;

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM refunds r
            WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
        ) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
    ) AS apparel_order_refund_share
FROM orders o
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
      AND LOWER(p.category) = 'apparel'
);

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM refunds r
            WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
        ) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
    ) AS electronics_order_refund_share
FROM orders o
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
      AND LOWER(p.category) = 'electronics'
);

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM refunds r
                WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
            ) THEN 1.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END
    ) AS refund_share
FROM orders o
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
      AND LOWER(p.category) = 'home'
);

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM refunds r
            WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
        ) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
    ) AS refunded_order_share
FROM orders o
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
      AND LOWER(p.category) = 'outdoors'
);

WITH beauty_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'beauty'
),
refunded_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id
    FROM refunds
)
SELECT
    COUNT(r.order_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS refund_share
FROM beauty_orders AS b
LEFT JOIN refunded_orders AS r ON r.order_id = b.order_id;

WITH garden_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM refunds r
            WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
        ) AS has_refund
    FROM orders o
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM order_items oi
        JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
        WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
          AND LOWER(p.category) = 'garden'
    )
)
SELECT AVG(CAST(has_refund AS DOUBLE)) AS garden_order_refund_share
FROM garden_orders;

WITH january_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share
FROM january_customers;

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1) * 1.0
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share_with_multiple_orders
FROM customer_order_counts;

WITH march_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share_with_multiple_orders
FROM march_customers;

WITH april_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1)::DOUBLE
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share_customers_with_multiple_orders
FROM april_customers;

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share
FROM customer_order_counts;

SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share_with_multiple_orders
FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY customer_id
